messages:
rachel (Finance): FYI found a gap on ACME-DED-042 invoice. Vendor passthrough credit (partner rebate) wasn't applied to the invoice so our April revenue looks overstated by $4,750. Uploaded supporting docs to s3: s3://redwood-bills/acme/ACME-DED-042.pdf :file_folder:
tyler (Billing Ops): Do we have the invoice line items? Is this a missing line or a negative line that got filtered?
rachel (Finance): Copying the relevant section from the bill PDF: ```
Line A | Dedicated reserved capacity - Apr 1-30 | 100 GPU-hours | $5.00/hr | $5,000.00
Line B | Partner rebate applied (should be) | -$4,750.00 | MISSING
Net due | $250.00
```
devon (FP&A): That $4.75k is under our $5k restatement threshold but it does affect the April close that we've already posted. We should do a prior-period adjusting journal and issue a credit memo. Also want to check if this is related to the pricing-experiment pass-through change from March.
tyler (Billing Ops): Looks like the passthrough flag wasn't set when the invoice renderer collapsed zero-amount lines. I'll log a billing ticket.
billing-bot (billing-bot): New ticket created: BILL-9001  Missing partner rebate line due to invoice renderer filter. Link: https://tickets.internal/BILL-9001
emma (Controller): For <$5k I approve a prior-period adjustment. Provide GL mapping and description. Make sure supporting docs include the vendor rebate contract and the invoice PDF.
rachel (Finance): Proposed JE to post in April period: debit 4002 Dedicated Revenue $4,750.00, credit 2105 Customer Credits $4,750.00. Journal reason: "correct missing partner rebate - ACME-DED-042". I'll draft and queue in NetSuite.
devon (FP&A): Also recommend increasing our unbilled reserved capacity accrual for May by $6k as a conservative buffer while billing fix ships. I'll push numbers to the month-end pack.
tyler (Billing Ops): I'll create the credit memo CM-2026-015 and re-run the invoice PDF. Also adding a note to the billing run: "BILL-9001 - passthrough flag regression".
rachel (Finance): Targeting posting EOD tomorrow to avoid audit inquiries. @emma please sign off on JE in NetSuite when I tag you.
billing-bot (billing-bot): Reminder: JE approval pending - NetSuite task 7890. Reminder scheduled 24h before EOD tomorrow.
emma (Controller): Signed off contingent on having the vendor rebate contract attached and ticket number in the support doc. Approving the JE mapping you proposed. :white_check_mark:
rachel (Finance): Great — will attach contract + ticket + regenerated invoice. Closing note: if we see >2 similar passthrough misses this month, we'll pause renderer deploys until fix is backported.
